# 02 — Data Dictionary

Generated from the PostgreSQL catalog after an ETL run. **Key** column: PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, UK = unique (natural key). **Origin** = source field in the Excel (lineage).

Special members in every dimension: `-1` = *No registrado* (missing in the source), `0` = *No aplica*.

## `dw.dim_fecha`

**Description.** Calendar dimension built by the team (not in the source).

**Transformation rules.** Generated by `etl.sp_cargar_dim_fecha` with `generate_series` 2022-01-01 → 2027-12-31; holidays from `etl.fn_festivos_co` (Easter + Ley Emiliani).

**Rows loaded:** 2,191

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fecha_sk` | integer | no | PK | Generated (no source column) |
| `fecha` | date | no | UK | Generated (no source column) |
| `dia` | smallint | no |  | Generated (no source column) |
| `dia_semana` | smallint | no |  | Generated (no source column) |
| `nombre_dia` | text | no |  | Generated (no source column) |
| `semana_iso` | smallint | no |  | Generated (no source column) |

## `dw.dim_turno`

**Description.** Shifts of the plant.

**Transformation rules.** Static catalog from Tabla18; variants such as `10pm-6am` are mapped to `10pm-6am (Turno 3)`; −1 = not recorded, 0 = not applicable.

**Rows loaded:** 8

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `turno_sk` | smallint | no | PK | Derived from the shift name |
| `turno_nk` | text | no | UK | Base De Datos.Turno (fallback: Unidad por display) / Tabla18 |
| `hora_inicio` | time without time zone | yes |  | Derived from the shift name |
| `hora_fin` | time without time zone | yes |  | Derived from the shift name |
| `duracion_h` | numeric(4,1) | yes |  | Derived from the shift name |
| `esquema` | text | no |  | Derived from the shift name |
| `es_nocturno` | boolean | no |  | Derived from the shift name |

## `dw.dim_maquina`

**Description.** Filling machines. SCD Type 2 on the ideal speed.

**Transformation rules.** Initial version = mode of `unidades *minuto` per machine in Tabla8/14/15/16, valid from 2022-01-01. New versions close the current row (vigente_hasta, es_actual=false) and insert a new one.

**Rows loaded:** 4

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maquina_sk` | integer | no | PK | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `maquina_nk` | text | no | UK | Base De Datos.Maquina / Tabla7 |
| `planta` | text | no |  | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `linea` | text | no |  | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `velocidad_ideal_upm` | numeric(6,1) | no |  | Tablas Desplegables (Tabla8/14/15/16)."unidades *minuto" |
| `vigente_desde` | date | no | UK | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `vigente_hasta` | date | no |  | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `es_actual` | boolean | no |  | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |
| `motivo_version` | text | yes |  | Generated by the ETL (SCD2 control) |

## `dw.dim_referencia`

**Description.** Product references (SKU).

**Transformation rules.** Names normalized (typos, spaces, `(12col)`→`(12 col)`, `30 cc`→`30cc`); brand and presentation parsed with regex; units per bale = most frequent value across machines.

**Rows loaded:** 63

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `referencia_sk` | integer | no | PK | Parsed from referencia_nk |
| `referencia_nk` | text | no | UK | Base De Datos.Referencia + Tabla8/14/15/16."Nombre de referencia" (normalized) |
| `marca` | text | no |  | Parsed from referencia_nk |
| `presentacion_cc` | smallint | yes |  | Parsed from referencia_nk |
| `presentacion` | text | no |  | Parsed from referencia_nk |
| `num_colores` | smallint | yes |  | Name "(N col)" or catalog "# colores" |
| `unidades_por_paca` | integer | yes |  | Catalog "Unidades * paca" |
| `en_catalogo` | boolean | no |  | Derived |

## `dw.dim_persona`

**Description.** Pseudonymized people (operators and maintenance staff). Role-playing dimension.

**Transformation rules.** `PER-` + 6 hex of SHA-256(salt + upper(name without accents)); placeholders `No`, `No aplica` → SK 0; empty → SK −1.

**Rows loaded:** 49

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `persona_sk` | integer | no | PK | Generated |
| `seudonimo` | text | no | UK | Base De Datos.Operario and Personal involucrado (pseudonymized) |
| `rol_principal` | text | no |  | Derived from the column of origin and "Área involucrada en subcodigo 5" |

## `dw.dim_causa_paro`

**Description.** Stoppage causes, flattened hierarchy Área → Código → Sistema → Componente.

**Transformation rules.** Built from Tabla2 (codes, impact area) and Sin_programación / Tabla9 / Tabla10 (subcodes). One level-1 member per code; level 2 for systems; level 3 for components of code 01. `clase_oee` from the OEE time model.

**Rows loaded:** 65

| `codigo` | smallint | no |  | Derived |
| `codigo_txt` | char(4) | no |  | Derived |
| `codigo_descripcion` | text | no |  | Tabla2.PARO |
| `codigo_label` | text | no |  | Derived |
| `sistema_clave` | text | yes |  | Derived |
| `sistema` | text | no |  | Sin_programación / Tabla9 / Tabla10 |
| `componente_clave` | text | yes |  | Derived |
| `componente` | text | no |  | Sin_programación (code 01) |
| `nivel_detalle` | smallint | no |  | Derived |
| `clase_oee` | text | no |  | Business rule (planned 08,15–18; quality 11,12; rest availability) |
| `es_planificado` | boolean | no |  | Derived |

## `dw.fact_produccion_turno`

**Description.** Production per shift form. Grain: machine × date × shift × operator × reference (or a non-scheduled shift).

**Transformation rules.** Only PRODUCCION and NO_PROGRAMADO records. Stoppage hours include the complement records linked to the form. PPT = hours − planned; run time = PPT − availability losses (floored at 0); ideal bales = run time × upm × 60 ÷ units per bale (machine × reference).

**Rows loaded:** 6,597

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `estado_sk` | smallint | no | FK → dw.dim_estado_turno | Derived by the ETL / FK lookup |

## `dw.fact_paro`

**Description.** Stoppages. Grain: one cause inside one source record (unpivot of the 18 code columns).

**Transformation rules.** One row per code with hours > 0. Subcode text normalized to `N.N[.X]`, legacy `4.x` → `5.x`; minutes = hours × 60. `persona_involucrada_sk` only for code 05.

**Rows loaded:** 16,482

| `referencia_sk` | integer | no | FK → dw.dim_referencia | Derived by the ETL / FK lookup |
| `operario_sk` | integer | no | FK → dw.dim_persona | Derived by the ETL / FK lookup |

## Staging and metadata

| Table | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `stg.base_datos_raw` | Raw copy of T_baseDeDatos as text (8,208 rows, names already pseudonymized). `source_row` = Excel row → lineage key used by `registro_id` in the facts |
| `stg.cat_codigos`, `stg.cat_subcodigos`, `stg.cat_referencias` | Catalogs read from *Tablas Desplegables* |
| `etl.run_log` | One row per ETL execution (status, source file SHA-256) |
| `etl.dq_log` | One row per cleaning rule per run: rows before / affected / after |
| `etl.reconciliacion` | Source totals vs loaded totals with the explanation of each difference |
| `sim.control`, `sim.reloj` | Simulator scenario per machine and simulated plant clock |
| `ops.alertas_recibidas` | Grafana notifications received by the alert-sink webhook |
